title: Finite discrete constructible finite-Tor complexes have etale antecedents
statement: Let X be a Noetherian scheme and A a finite discrete commutative ring. Fix a ring-object isomorphism eR from the sheafified constant lifted A-ring presheaf at the profinite point to the continuous condensed ring of A, with IsMonHom eR.hom. For an internal complex K in the bounded constructible finite-Tor class [sk-def-sfb-constructible], there is an ordinary etale bounded constructible complex L [def-weil-pbc-constructible-complexes], an ordered finite interval in which L has Tor amplitude [def-kun-tor-amplitude], and an isomorphism from the image of L under derived comparisonUpperStar followed by derived finiteComparisonRealization [det-ctf-finite-comparison-localizing] to K. The derived categories are those of [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], and the coefficient is the finite ring of [lem-weil-pbc-finite-discrete-condensed-ring-constant].

source.place: The equivalence; expressed in the finite discrete internal-module and ordinary fixed-scalar presentations used by the compactness proof.

proof.text: Use finiteComparisonRealization_exact to install the coefficient equivalence and take a preimage P of K under its derived functor R. The counit gives eP : R(P) ≅ K. Isomorphism invariance of constantModelBoundedConstructible, together with the generic finiteTorAmplitude isomorphism instance, transports hK to R(P).

A Noetherian scheme is quasi-compact and quasi-separated. Apply the reverse implication of finiteComparisonGenerators_identification to P with its transported internal constructible finite-Tor predicate. This gives an etale bounded constructible finite-Tor complex L and an isomorphism eL from its ordinary derived comparison image to P. This uses the bounded finite-Tor generator correspondence directly, without separately reflecting fixed-scalar constructibility and descending it again.

Unpack the finite Tor amplitude of L as an interval [a,b]. Enlarge it by DerivedCategory.torAmplitudeIn.mono to [min a b,max a b], which is ordered even if the original interval is empty. Apply the proved source helper Etale.DerivedCategory.hasTorAmplitudeIn_iff_torAmplitudeIn: it expresses canonical t-structure bounds on each degree-zero tensor as the identical cohomology vanishing predicate hasTorAmplitudeIn. Using this API avoids unfolding the derived tensor construction. Apply R to eL and compose with eP for the required internal comparison isomorphism. No nonempty-scheme or nonzero-ring assumption is introduced.

proof_origin.place: The equivalence paragraph: apply the existing finiteComparisonGenerators_identification directly after taking the exact coefficient-equivalence preimage; order its Tor interval and compose the ambient comparison isomorphisms.

lean.statement:
theorem finiteDiscreteCtfOrigin
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian X]
    (A : Type) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    [TopologicalSpace A] [DiscreteTopology A] [IsTopologicalRing A]
    (eR : Sheaf.sheafifyRingPresheaf.{u + 1, u, u + 1}
      (coherentTopology Profinite.{u})
      ((Functor.const Profinite.{u}ᵒᵖ).obj (RingCat.of (ULift.{u + 1} A))) ≅
        Profinite.continuousMapRingObj.{u} A) [IsMonHom eR.hom]
    (K : DerivedCategory (pulledBackModuleObjects
      (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj A) X))
    (hK : (constantModelBoundedConstructible (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj A) X ⊓
      fun M ↦ _root_.DerivedCategory.finiteTorAmplitude _ M) K) :
    ∃ L : Etale.DerivedCategoryModule (ULift.{u + 1} A) X,
      Etale.DerivedCategory.isBoundedConstructible (ULift.{u + 1} A) X L ∧
      (∃ a b : ℤ, a ≤ b ∧
        Etale.DerivedCategory.hasTorAmplitudeIn (ULift.{u + 1} A) X a b L) ∧
      Nonempty (((comparisonUpperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} A)) X).mapDerivedCategory ⋙
        (finiteComparisonRealization A X eR).mapDerivedCategory).obj L ≅ K)
